verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows TWC publishing a readable robots.txt. The probe of the application host (apps.twc.texas.gov/robots.txt) got a transport-level connection reset with no HTTP response, so no robots policy could be read there, and no evidence covers a robots.txt on the main www.twc.texas.gov site. Robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence is 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
